subject: Post-call summary — vector scoring & SLO alignment
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Luke Martin <luke.martin@shopnexus.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call summary — vector scoring & SLO alignment

Hi Luke,

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap from our side and what we heard as the top priorities:

- Primary pain: search relevance drift for long-tail products; current rerank step adds significant cost and unpredictable latency during flash sales.
- Current stack: Weaviate on GKE + Faiss shards for ANN (AVX quantized), metadata in Postgres; nightly full reindex (~1M vectors/day) and ad-hoc backfills.
- Index size (what you estimated): ~120M live vectors (catalog + user history). Peak QPS pattern: baseline ~250 qps, spiking to ~1.5k qps during campaigns.
- Success criteria you called out:
  - p95 latency for rerank + model scoring <= 120 ms (end-to-end)
  - NDCG improvement >= 12% vs current baseline
  - Cost target: <$35 per 1M queries for the rerank step
- Operational notes: batch cold-starts for re-ranking run in 512-concurrent tokens; many queries are short, with high prefix overlap.

Proposed next steps:
1) Redwood benchmark: run a 1-hour simulated traffic test against a small-sharded config that mirrors your distribution (we'll need a sample query set).
2) POC options: Hosted API pilot vs. Dedicated pool (we'll outline cost/delta).
3) Technical deep-dive: Marcus to scope KV-prefix caching and quantization tuning for your workload.

Attached: sample-query-set.csv (sample 10k queries), initial evaluation plan (arch-diagram.svg), brief pricing worksheet.

Can you confirm the index size and whether the 120M estimate is accurate? Also prefer next meeting slots on Mon/Tue next week.

Best,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: sample-query-set.csv, arch-diagram.svg, pricing-worksheet.xlsx

From: Luke Martin <luke.martin@shopnexus.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call summary — vector scoring & SLO alignment

Neha,

Thanks for the summary — helpful. Couple clarifications:
- Index size is closer to 250M vectors if you include session-derived embeddings; sorry I undershot earlier.
- Infrastructure: we run Weaviate on GKE but most of the heavy reads hit Faiss shards (quantized) with an SSD-backed cold tier in S3 snapshots. Metadata is in a Redis cache in front of Postgres.
- Batch cadence: nightly full reindex is ~2.5M vectors; we also do hourly incremental batches of ~20-40k vectors.

Cost target is tight: we are aiming for ~$30 / 1M queries for the rerank-only portion (not including upstream retrieval). Latency target is firm — p95 <= 100ms would be ideal.

A benchmark would be great. I can share a sanitized traffic dump and the scoring function for 10 representative MLPs. I'm available Tue 2026-07-13 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 2026-07-14 14:00–15:00 PT.

Luke
Luke Martin
Head of Search
ShopNexus
luke.martin@shopnexus.com
attachments: traffic-dump-sample.json (will share via Drive link)
